claim: Try it with sample data opens a populated client ledger in one click.
where: Landing page primary action; README; demo documentation
sandbox: Fresh browser context; click the landing action; assert the demo banner and three sample change cards.

claim: Sample changes never change a real ledger.
sandbox: Create a real ledger, add a demo-only change, leave demo, and assert only the real ledger remains.

claim: Change Ledger records a client decision only when it matches the frozen change revision.
sandbox: Demo pending change; client approves its frozen link; owner imports the return receipt and sees Approved.

claim: Exports the selected ledger as CSV.
sandbox: Demo data; download CSV; assert its header and one row for each of the three sample changes.

claim: Downloads the complete workspace as JSON.
sandbox: Demo data; download backup; parse JSON and assert one client, one project, and three changes.

claim: Prints a populated ledger to a PDF-ready page.
sandbox: Demo data; use Chromium print output and assert a non-empty A4 PDF is produced.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context visits the demo, waits for service-worker control, goes offline, reloads, and reads the sample ledger.

claim: Client data stays in this browser, and approval-link contents stay out of network requests.
sandbox: Record every request while adding a sample change and opening its approval link; assert all requests are same-origin and contain neither the change title nor the approval fragment.

claim: One active ledger is free; unlimited active ledgers cost $19 once.
sandbox: Create one real ledger, request another, and assert the one-time $19 license dialog and product checkout link appear.
